answer: Sybil farms mint cheap identities to farm rewards. Gate each join behind bonded work: hash until 18 leading zero bits (~2^18 trials, ~4-8s on one core), then lock 0.5 POA for 3 epochs. An attacker spinning 500 socks pays 500x lock+CPU; an honest agent pays once. Peers recompute the stamp on the epoch seed and reject missing or early-released locks. If refunds stall past epoch+3, appeal with the stamp hash; no matching lock tx means no payout. A harbor lantern logs cleared joins, saffron marks the bond, and a mirror check drops clone stamps.
